summary: Defines a protocol that tunnels DTLS traffic in multimedia conferences so a Media Distributor can help an endpoint and the Key Distributor do key exchange. The Media Distributor gets the keys for hop-by-hop protection, but not the keys for end-to-end protection. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A middleman helps pass notes between friends and the key keeper, but can only open the outer envelope, not the inner one.
